title: Japanese Tofu Stir Fry
description: A quick and easy Japanese-inspired stir fry made with crispy tofu and mixed vegetables. This dish is perfect for a weeknight dinner.
instructions: Heat 2 tablespoons of sesame oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat.
Add the grated ginger and minced garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add the sliced bell pepper and carrots and cook for 3-4 minutes, or until tender.
Add the tofu and cook for an additional 2-3 minutes, or until golden brown.
Pour in the sour Japanese stir sauce and stir to combine.
Cook for an additional 1-2 minutes, or until the sauce has thickened.
Serve hot and garnish with sesame seeds and chopped scallions, if desired.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
